title: The Girl on the Train
author: Paula Hawkins
summary: Rachel, a woman struggling with drinking and a collapsed marriage, watches the same house from her commuter train every day. When a woman from that house goes missing, she becomes convinced she saw something.
readIf: you like twisty domestic thrillers with narrators you can't fully trust.
skipIf: you want likeable characters or a calm read.

pairings.reason: The defining twisty marriage thriller, with colder, sharper writing.
Another thriller where an unreliable narrator watches a neighbour and sees something terrible.
Another thriller built on a narrator who cannot trust her own memory.
